## Evidence

- [ ] I read the applicable `AGENTS.md` and development workflow.
- [ ] I inspected current code, tests, contracts, routes, and dependency versions.
- [ ] Verified facts, assumptions, and unresolved decisions are separated.

## Change control

- [ ] A feature checklist is linked when this changes behavior, contracts, data, security, publication, dependencies, or runtime configuration.
- [ ] The approved failing test is unchanged, or this PR is behavior-neutral.
- [ ] API changes update the canonical contract and all affected snapshots without an undocumented breaking change.
- [ ] No secret, private record, unpublished content, invented fact, or unapproved media was added.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the repository verification commands documented in the README.
- [ ] Migration, compatibility, rollback, accessibility, and failure states are addressed when applicable.
- [ ] Remaining risks and follow-up work are recorded.
